rationale: The stock gapped up sharply at open to $14.20 then collapsed nearly 17% to sit at $11.90, just 0.46% above today's low with price in the bottom 2.1% of the range — a severe intraday downtrend with no sign of stabilization. With only 22 minutes to close, the last candle showed a sharp volume spike (24,823 shares) driving price to the session low, suggesting continued selling pressure rather than a reversal. The risk/reward for either direction is unfavorable: a long risks further breakdown through the low with minimal time for recovery, while a short this close to the session low and market close carries gap-back risk and forced liquidation exposure.
